component.name: Tresse GUI
component.summary: Keep folders in Tresse and sync them

description.p: A desktop window over Tresse: pick any folder, keep its history with the same repository format the terminal reads, and sync it with a Tresse server or your own S3-compatible bucket, end-to-end encrypted.

A folder that already has a Tresse repository is added as it is; a new one is started in place. One adaptive window: a list and a sidebar on a desktop, a list on a phone, written once for a pointer and a finger.
